Columns (4)--(6) partition the post-period around the two Bitcoin-specific shocks the cross-coin design cannot difference out. Column (4) truncates the post-window before the April 2024 halving and rests on the two post-treatment months printed in the table, which is far too few to establish anything and is reported because our pre-analysis committed to reporting it. Column (5) truncates the post-window before the November 2024 US election and is the estimate our pre-analysis designated as ETF-attributable. Column (6) restricts the post-period to the months after the election and should be read as the ETF plus the post-election policy regime rather than as an ETF effect. Randomization $p$-values have a floor of 0.10 on nine donor coins.
